text:
maya: heads up — found a parity gap between Node SDK and REST for admin roles endpoint. REST has POST /v1/admin/roles:assign but SDK doesn't expose client.admin.assignRole(...). Trying to onboard a customer and hit the wall.

sam: can you paste the REST request you used?

maya: sure — reproduced with curl:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/roles:assign" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"user_id":"u_123","role":"model-admin"}'
```

maya: Node SDK only has client.roles.create / list / delete, no assign or bulk assign. Also noticed SDK throws 401 -> SDK retry wrapper retries indefinitely instead of failing fast; REST call from CLI gives 403 with proper message.

sam: hmm — thanks. that's two issues: missing endpoint binding and retry/auth behavior. Can you share SDK version?

maya: using @redwood/sdk v0.7.1 (npm). sample code:
```
const Redwood = require('@redwood/sdk');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });

await client.roles.createAssignment({ userId: 'u_123', role: 'model-admin' });
```

maya: this errors: "Unknown function createAssignment" at runtime.

kevin: quick note — admin endpoints are behind extra scope "admin:roles" and internal path change. We added server-side compatibility for REST. SDK binding slipped through because we restructured the admin surface in the openapi, but the SDK generator excluded "x-internal": true paths. We should have flagged "roles:assign" as public. My bad.

olivia: for immediate workaround, Maya — you can call REST directly from Node:
```
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/roles:assign', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ user_id: 'u_123', role: 'model-admin' }),
});
```

olivia: note: you need token with admin scope. That explains 401 vs 403 behavior — SDK was wrapping and masking scopes, causing misleading 401s and an aggressive retry loop.

maya: thanks. filed a quick reproduction in a sample app repo: https://github.com/redwood/sample-tenant-onboard/issues/48

devx-bot: created issue RNF-2345 in repo redwood-js-sdk — "admin roles endpoint missing; retry/auth drift" (https://git.internal/redwood/rnf/2345) :raised_hands:

sam: I'll own adding the binding. Plan: patch generator to include that path and add explicit auth scope check in client that surfaces 403 + no retry for auth failures. Will open PR today with tests and a small sample app snippet.

kevin: will add an endpoint-level flag so generator won't drop public admin endpoints accidentally. Also review our openapi tags for "x-public" vs "x-internal".

olivia: QA note — add an integration test that hits admin scope with a test key to verify correct error codes and that SDK doesn't retry auth errors.

maya: timeline for us? onboarding is blocked for monday.

sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/redwood-js-sdk/pull/72. small change, generated bindings + unit tests. requesting a patch release (0.7.2). Also added sample app repro to sample-tenant-onboard repo.

kevin: deployed generator fix to staging. we need one more review on edge case where path contains colon (roles:assign) — generator escaped ok.

devx-bot: release note draft: "Fix: Node SDK bindings for admin role management (roles:assign) + proper auth error handling to avoid infinite retries." scheduled for 0.7.2.

olivia: closing loop — Maya can you confirm sample app flow works after PR merged?

maya: confirmed on staging: assignment succeeds, errors are 403 when missing scope and no retry. :tada: 

sam: shipping 0.7.2 patch to npm now.

maya: thanks everyone. please add a short blurb in onboarding guide about admin scopes and token generation (I added a doc PR).

kevin: added onboarding doc link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/219/files#diff-admin-scopes

devx-bot: thread archived.
